{"metadata":{"description":"A playable pixel companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): platform-jumps over chat messages, WASD controllable, with a full nurture system fed by your agent's real token usage.","id":"gh:1338240327","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-pet-sprite","slug":"BlackBearCC/dsh-pet-sprite","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A playable pixel companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): platform-jumps over chat messages, WAS"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"D controllable, with a full nurture system fed by your agent's real token usage."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-pet-sprite"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A **playable** pixel companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Not a wallpaper mascot — the pet lives in your chat area, **platform-jumps over your message bubbles"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"**, and you can grab the controls yourself. It also carries a full nurture system fed by your agent'"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"s **real token usage**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Three companions, one egg** — on first launch a speckled egg wobbles quietly in the corner (neve"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"r a forced popup). Click it to hatch and pick your companion: **Poka** the white-haired girl, **Mika"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"n** the tabby cat, or **Puff** the DeepSeek-blue baby whale. Switch anytime from the care panel.
- *"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"*Generate & share your own companion** — describe it in one sentence ("a green dino with round glass"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"es") and the model draws a new pixel sprite for 100 star coins, animated automatically. Every genera"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ted pet exports as a `.dsh-pet.json` file friends can import for free.
- **Left-click to chat** — cl"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"icking the pet opens a small chat box beside it. Replies come from the model you already configured "},{"id":"p6s8","text":"in DSH (provider + model pickable in the care panel's settings tab), so it reuses your existing cred"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"entials — no extra API key. The pet answers in-character as a speech bubble; the last 30 turns persi"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"st locally.
- **Platform jumping playground** — the pet treats chat message bubbles as platforms: it"},{"id":"p6s11","text":" wanders, climbs bubble edges, hops between messages on its own.
- **Player control** — click empty "},{"id":"p6s12","text":"space in the chat area to take over: `A/D` move, `Space` jump (double-tap mid-air for a skill jump),"},{"id":"p6s13","text":" `W` climb, `S` drop through platforms. Idle 10s and it goes back to autonomous mode.
- **Agent-stat"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"e reactions** — while the model streams, the pet sits down and types on its own tiny laptop; idle, i"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"t blinks, strolls, and naps. Each companion has its own ambient chatter.
- **Nurture system** (porte"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"d from the PetClaw engine): mood / power / health attributes with decay and linkage, Lv.1–100 with t"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"itles, coins, inventory, and a shop with level-gated + daily-limited items.
- **Token-bound economy*"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"* — your input tokens drain the pet's power, each completed reply converts output tokens into XP, da"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"ily-first-open grants login coins, leveling slows attribute decay."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Right-click the pet to open the care panel (status / interactions / inventory / shop / settings), do"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"cked right next to the character."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Then restart DSH (`dsh web`) and open any conversation — the pet spawns at the bottom of the chat fl"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"n restart DSH (`dsh web`) and open any conversation — the pet spawns at the bottom of the chat flow."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> `lib/` build output is committed, so git installs work without authorizing build scripts. To rebui"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ld from source: `pnpm install && pnpm build`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Registers into the DSH Web UI `shell.overlay` slot via the `dsh.client` browser-plugin manifest.
-"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" The node half mounts two exact HTTP routes (`GET /plugins/dsh-pet-sprite/models`, `POST /plugins/ds"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"h-pet-sprite/chat`) that proxy `ctx.llm` — the same LLM runtime the coding agent uses, with your con"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"figured providers and keys.
- Platforms are discovered from `[data-chat-flow-key]` message nodes; th"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"e arena is the conversation scroll viewport. Everything adapts live to scrolling and new messages.
-"},{"id":"p13s6","text":" Game state and chat history (attributes, level, coins, inventory, last 30 chat turns, model choice)"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" persist in `localStorage` — no telemetry, zero external network calls."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- DSH developer preview (tested against `0.1.0-rc.7`). DSH is iterating fast with breaking changes; "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"pin a commit (`github:<you>/dsh-pet-sprite#<sha>`) if stability matters."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
